name: Japanese Chicken or Tamago Udon Soup
whyItWorks: Thick white wheat udon noodles are ultra-soft and slippery; mild dashi and soy broth settles cramps and restores electrolytes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer pre-cooked vacuum-packed udon noodles in chicken broth with a splash of soy sauce and mirin. Top with thinly sliced skinless chicken breast and swirled egg drop.
